name: En Coulisse
source:
En Coulisse is a french horror visual novel taking place at the Great Theater of Bordeaux in 2025.

When Quentin and his friends come out of a drunken night out, they decide to enter an abandoned building, curious to know what is hiding there. This small group of young people will then experience gloomy and terrifying events.

As Quentin, a young man of 20, you wake up alone in the Grand theater with no memory of the night before.  Finding no escape, you must seek to relive the course of his evening to determine the cause of his amnesia and find a way out

Through the eyes and ears of Quentin, you will discover a double narration. The search for memories in the present and the discovery of the same memories in the past.

[From [url=https://abyssalisma.itch.io/en-coulisse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《En Coulisse》是一部法國恐怖視覺小說，故事發生在2025年的波爾多大劇院。

昆汀和朋友們在一夜酩酊之後，決定進入一棟廢棄建築，想弄清裡面藏著什麼。這群年輕人隨後遭遇了陰鬱而恐怖的事件。

20歲的青年昆汀醒來時，發現自己獨自一人身處大劇院裡，對前一晚的事毫無記憶。無處可逃的他必須試著重現當晚的經過，查明失憶的原因，並找到離開的方法。

你將透過昆汀的雙眼與雙耳體驗雙線敘事：一條線在當下搜尋記憶，另一條線則回到過去，重新發現同一段記憶。

[摘自[url=https://abyssalisma.itch.io/en-coulisse]Itch.io[/url]]
